CREATE TRIGGER archive_classic_stack_before_shrink
        BEFORE UPDATE OF json_data ON librarysettingsjsondb
        FOR EACH ROW
        WHEN COALESCE(json_array_length(OLD.json_data, '$.pluginIDs'), 0)
           > COALESCE(json_array_length(NEW.json_data, '$.pluginIDs'), 0)
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO config_history (
                entity_type, entity_id, change_type, created_at, expires_at, payload
            ) VALUES (
                'classicStack', OLD.id, 'stackShrink', unixepoch() * 1000,
                (unixepoch() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60) * 1000,
                json_object(
                    'name', json_extract(OLD.json_data, '$.name'),
                    'pluginIDs', json(COALESCE((
                        SELECT json_group_array(json(old_plugin.value))
                        FROM json_each(OLD.json_data, '$.pluginIDs') AS old_plugin
                        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1
                            FROM json_each(NEW.json_data, '$.pluginIDs') AS new_plugin
                            WHERE json_extract(new_plugin.value, '$._id')
                                = json_extract(old_plugin.value, '$._id')
                        )
                    ), '[]'))
                )
            );
        END

CREATE TRIGGER archive_flow_before_update
        BEFORE UPDATE OF json_data ON flowsjsondb
        FOR EACH ROW
        WHEN json_remove(OLD.json_data, '$.priority')
           <> json_remove(NEW.json_data, '$.priority')
         AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM config_history
            WHERE entity_type = 'flow'
              AND entity_id = OLD.id
              AND change_type = 'update'
              AND created_at >= (unixepoch() - 5) * 1000
         )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO config_history (
                entity_type, entity_id, change_type, created_at, expires_at, payload
            ) VALUES (
                'flow', OLD.id, 'update', unixepoch() * 1000,
                (unixepoch() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60) * 1000, OLD.json_data
            );
            DELETE FROM config_history
            WHERE entity_type = 'flow'
              AND entity_id = OLD.id
              AND change_type = 'update'
              AND id NOT IN (
                  SELECT id FROM config_history
                  WHERE entity_type = 'flow'
                    AND entity_id = OLD.id
                    AND change_type = 'update'
                  ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
                  LIMIT 30
              );
        END

CREATE TRIGGER archive_library_before_update
        BEFORE UPDATE OF json_data ON librarysettingsjsondb
        FOR EACH ROW
        WHEN json_remove(
                OLD.json_data, '$.priority', '$.totalTranscodeCount',
                '$.totalHealthCheckCount', '$.sizeDiff', '$.scanButtons',
                '$.scanFound', '$.navItemSelected'
             ) <> json_remove(
                NEW.json_data, '$.priority', '$.totalTranscodeCount',
                '$.totalHealthCheckCount', '$.sizeDiff', '$.scanButtons',
                '$.scanFound', '$.navItemSelected'
             )
         AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM config_history
            WHERE entity_type = 'library'
              AND entity_id = OLD.id
              AND change_type = 'update'
              AND created_at >= (unixepoch() - 5) * 1000
         )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO config_history (
                entity_type, entity_id, change_type, created_at, expires_at, payload
            ) VALUES (
                'library', OLD.id, 'update', unixepoch() * 1000,
                (unixepoch() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60) * 1000, OLD.json_data
            );
            DELETE FROM config_history
            WHERE entity_type = 'library'
              AND entity_id = OLD.id
              AND change_type = 'update'
              AND id NOT IN (
                  SELECT id FROM config_history
                  WHERE entity_type = 'library'
                    AND entity_id = OLD.id
                    AND change_type = 'update'
                  ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
                  LIMIT 30
              );
        END
